about_the_game:
Shattered Chess is a fast, hypnotic roguelike remix of chess. You get 10 moves to beat a target score. Enemy pieces are scattered and don’t move—your job is to chain captures for massive combos. Miss a capture and the chain breaks. Between fights, visit the shop to buy/upgrade passives and effects, then face unique bosses that warp the rules.

HOW IT PLAYS

  • Pick a King Challenge – a difficulty modifier that applies a run-long drawback (no player bonus) and forces you to adapt.

  • Plan 10 moves – every decision matters; find the most optimal routes.

  • Chain captures – take multiple pieces in one combo to multiply your score.

  • Cooldown matters – a capturing piece goes on a 1-move cooldown, so rotate your lineup or build around reducing/offsetting cooldowns.

  • Beat the target – hit or exceed the enemy’s score to win the match.

  • Shop between fights – buy and upgrade passives/effects to overcome obstacles.

  • Boss encounters – every few stages, a boss changes the rules in surprising ways.

  • Endless mode – after a successful run, push your luck and climb as far as you can.

BUILDCRAFTING

  • Specialize or diversify – invest in passives that boost one piece type, or get rewarded for switching between different pieces within the same combo.

  • Mechanic-focused builds – stack cooldown reduction or zone effects that boost your score when you plan and play around them.

  • Mitigate the drawback – draft passives/effects that help you bypass the negatives of your King Challenge.

KEY FEATURES

  • Chess-inspired roguelike with quick, satisfying runs.

  • Combo-driven scoring that rewards creative planning and risk.

  • Powerful passives & synergies for expressive builds.

  • Unique bosses that push you to think differently.

  • Atmospheric 2D pixel art with a moody, light horror-tinged vibe.

  • Highly replayable: new enemy layouts and builds every run.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel/AMD dual-core 2.0 GHz
  • Memory: 4 MB RAM
  • Graphics: DX11 compatible (Intel HD 4000 / GTX 650)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Any
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel i5 / Ryzen 3
  • Memory: 8 MB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 1050 / RX 560
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Any

short_description: Chess remixed as a fast roguelike. You get 10 moves to beat a target score by chaining captures into big combos. Build around piece types or mechanics like cooldown, buy/upgrade passives and one-shot effects in the shop, tackle rule-twisting bosses and King Challenges.
